items.title: Build the /roadmap build-status page
items.summary: A dependency-free page at /roadmap, backed by data/roadmap.json, that renders one table per status plus in-flight section tables. The living record of work on this project.
items.notes: Exists so work is tracked in one honest place before anything depends on it — storage is a single JSON file the assistant edits directly (no DB, no admin UI, no auth, by design). Kept dependency-free on purpose: no CDN, no build step, so it still opens in five years. Verified the /roadmap route returns 200 and /roadmap.json parses. Observed conflict I did NOT silently resolve: the pasted rules 3-4 (done newest-first, everything else oldest-first as a queue) contradict the follow-up 'order everything newest at the top' — I implemented rules 2-4 as written and flagged it for a ruling rather than quietly picking one.
